properties.name: Northwest to British Columbia
properties.why: Ties BPA to BC Hydro at the Canadian border. Power can flow either way.
properties.lines: Custer (BPA)–Ingledow (BCH) 500 kV line 1 & 2|Boundary (BPA)–Waneta 230 kV (normally open)|Boundary (BPA)–Nelway (BCH) 230 kV (normally closed)

properties.name: West of Cascades North
properties.why: Carries power from Grand Coulee and the other Columbia dams over the mountains to Seattle and Puget Sound.
properties.lines: Chief Joseph–Monroe 500 kV|Schultz–Raver 1, 3, 4 500 kV|Chief Joe–Snohomish 345 kV lines 3 & 4|Rocky Reach–Maple Valley 345 kV|Grand Coulee–Olympia 230 kV|Rocky Reach–Cascade 230 kV|Bettas Road–Covington No. 1 230 kV|Schultz–Echo Lake 500 kV

properties.name: West of Cascades South
properties.why: Carries power from the Gorge west to Portland and the Willamette Valley. Most of the Gorge's wind, including Avangrid's, sits east of it.
properties.lines: Big Eddy–Ostrander 500 kV|Ashe–Marion 500 kV|Buckley–Marion 500 kV|Knight–Ostrander 500 kV|John Day–Marion 500 kV|McNary–Ross 345 kV|Big Eddy–McLoughlin 230 kV|Big Eddy–Chemawa 230 kV|Midway–N. Bonneville 230 kV|Jones Canyon–Santiam 230 kV|Big Eddy–Troutdale 230 kV|Round Butte–Bethel 230 kV

properties.name: Montana to Northwest
properties.why: Brings power from Montana into the Northwest. The lines that define it are farther east in Montana and Idaho; the badge marks where it heads into the map.

properties.name: Idaho to Northwest
properties.why: Ties the Northwest to Idaho. Includes the 500 kV line from Hemingway in Idaho to Summer Lake in Oregon.
properties.lines: Hemingway–Summer Lake 500 kV|Imnaha–Lolo 230 kV|Hells Canyon–Hurricane 230 kV|North Powder–LaGrande 230 kV|Hines–Harney 115 kV

properties.name: Pacific DC Intertie
properties.why: Sends Columbia power 846 miles to Sylmar near Los Angeles. It's DC and has no stops along the way.
properties.lines: Celilo to Sylmar 500 kV DC line

properties.name: California-Oregon Intertie
properties.why: Three 500 kV AC lines from southern Oregon into Northern California: two from Malin to Round Mountain and one from Captain Jack to Olinda.
properties.lines: Malin to Round Mt. 500 kV (2 lines)|Captain Jack–Olinda 500 kV line (COTP)
